autoStart.description: If set to `true` then this {@link Engine} will auto start on every node of every target node-pool.

initializingNodeAvoidanceDuration.description:
Maximum time to wait for an {@link Engine} to initialize after it has been started.

For example if {@link Engine} loading model for 5 minutes, it's recommended to set this value to 5 minutes to
avoid dispatching to {@link App.Node} that started less than 5 minutes ago.

initialStateObjsPerRuntime.description:
Map specifying which objects' state should be loaded.

key - The {@link Action.Requirement requirement} in which {@link WithInitialState object}'s state should be initialized.
value - The list of {@link WithInitialState object}s that should be loaded in memory.

`py-py4j` is only supported {@link ImplLanguage.Executor}. Please use it in provided
{@link Action.Requirement requirements} or keep empty to default to it.

title:
Defines {@link WithInitialState.Engine#deploy deployment} spec for {@link WithInitialState.Engine}.

{@link WithInitialState.Engine} defines own implementation logic for initializing
{@link #initialStateObjsPerRuntime provided} {@link WithInitialState object}s. This logic can be overridden by
supplying `onInterpreterStart` lambda as part of {@link App.Node.ThreadPool.Config.Py.Simple config} of
{@link #threadPool} {@link App.Node.ThreadPool.Spec#py spec}.
name: WithInitialState.Engine.DeploySpec
